entities.name: Saʻīd ʻAbd al-Laṭīf Fūdah
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sa'id 'Abd al-Latif Foudah is a Palestinian-Jordanian Shafi'i-Ash'ari scholar of Islamic theology (kalam), logic (mantiq), legal theory, and the Chief Theology and Philosophy Adviser to the Imam al-Razi Chair at the King Hussein bin Talal Mosque in Amman, Jordan. He is best known for his criticism of the Wahhabi movement, Ibn Taymiyya and his followers.
